title: bursera aracouchini
intro: Bursera aracouchini, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in the countries of Peru, Ecuador, and Bolivia. Palo Santo is known for its medicinal properties and is used to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and alpha-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as calming and relaxing properties, and may help to reduce pain and inflammation.
